**Finding: COMPLIANT** — no redline proposed.

The renewal mechanic is buried in the mis-numbered "13. TERM OF AGREEMENT" paragraph (p0078), which sits under the § 12 INDEMNITY section ref rather than its own section — hence the planner's "likely absent" hint.

Assessment against the rule:
- **Renewal term:** successive **one-year** periods — matches preferred (12 months); no multi-year auto-renewal, so no walk-away risk.
- **Non-renewal notice window:** **30 days**, exercisable by either party including us — matches the preferred position and is well inside the fallback's 60-day ceiling.
- **Additional exit comfort:** Section 14 (p0079) lets services run only to the last day of the month following our written termination notice.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged as deviations (minor sub-elements per playbook semantics):
- No Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal.
- No express cap on renewal-term price uplifts — § 6 (p0047) only freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year and adds an MFN on rates.

These two points are worth raising as non-blocking asks (a renewal reminder and a lesser-of-CPI-or-3% uplift cap) in negotiation, but the clause meets the preferred position on its material terms and should not be redlined.
